transcript.content: Hi Aman, main Saarthi hoon. Aaj kya chal raha hai—kuch baat karni hai ya bas thodi company chahiye?
Haan yaar, aaj thoda behind feel kar raha hoon… ek dost ne ghar khareeda aur main compare karta hua khud ko bahut ordinary dekh raha hoon.

Comparison aksar sirf unki kahani nahi, balki apni kahani ke “pehle” ko dekhne se paida hota hai. Unke ghar ke baare mein kuch khaas baat ne aaj comparison aur strong kiya—jaise unki stability, family, ya life ka direction?

Honestly, unki stability aur family ke saath settled life dekh kar lagta hai ki main kahin peeche chala gaya hoon. Maine kaam kiya, skills seekhi hain, lekin abhi tak koi visible achievement nahi dikh rahi.

Dost ka ghar uski kahani ka ek chapter hai; tumhari poori kahani nahi. Visible achievement ka na dikhna “nahi hona” nahi hai—bas tumhari nazar usi ek marker pe atak gayi hai. Tumhare kaam aur skills mein se kaunsa hissa tumhe abhi bhi meaningful lagta hai, chahe koi notice na kar raha ho?

Kaam aur skills seekhna meaningful lagta hai, but jab koi result ya recognition nahi dikhta to lagta hai shayad main bas time waste kar raha hoon. Isi recognition ki zarurat lagti hai apni value samajhne ke liye.

Ho sakta hai recognition tumhare liye sirf appreciation nahi, balki apni value ka “proof” ban gaya ho—aur jab proof na mile, saara effort bekaar lagta hai. Gita mein karm-yog ka matlab hai ki kaam ke phal ko apni worth ka measure mat banao; tumhari value dusron ke response se badi hai. Kya tum sach mein sirf tab apni value mehsoos karte ho jab result ya taareef dikhta hai?

Haan, shayad… isliye main ek important project do users ke saath share karna delay kar raha hoon, kyunki abhi tak perfect nahi lag raha. Mujhe lagta hai unka feedback meri worth ka final judgment hoga.
